title: Why Does Ice Float? #water #science
description:
Most solids sink in their own liquid. Ice floats because freezing locks water molecules into an open, six-sided pattern that takes up about 9% more room than liquid water.

Sources
- USGS Water Science School, Water Density
- Wikipedia, Ice Ih
- Wikipedia, Properties of water

Can you name another substance that expands when it freezes? Tell me in the comments.
